cta_text.description: Fix cycle 3 item 4: the ONE CTA button text for this page. Must be exactly one of this schema's top-level allowed_cta_texts, with {short_name} filled in with the product's actual short_name (fix cycle 4 item 3) . The renderer reuses it verbatim in the hero and the repeat CTA -- choose it once here, never repeat/vary it elsewhere.

cta_url.description: The CTA's destination URL, reused everywhere cta_text is.

hero.description: product name, one-line promise from the ad angle, price, financing line, hero image.

promise.description: The page's headline: one line that answers the ad the visitor clicked -- the ad's main claim or angle, rewritten for this product page. Keep it descriptive, not a numeric claim -- put any number/price/percent in price_line or financing_line instead; if the promise must state one, cite it in hero.claim_ids (the gate fails an uncited number here). This cartridge has no separate `headline` field -- the simplicity gate (harness/simplicity.py) measures this field's word count against this schema's own headline_word_band, the same way the other cartridges' `headline` field is measured.

claim_ids.description: Claim ids backing hero.promise. Only needed when the promise states a number, price, percentage or trigger word; omit otherwise.

price_line.description: e.g. text: '$8,250'. Only add a compare-at/'was $X' figure if facts_pack.product.compare_at_price is non-null. Must carry the product's price claim_id.

financing_line.description: text: must be exactly the allowed financing sentence given in the prompt's Financing rule, verbatim -- never a freeform monthly figure, APR, or lender name typed in directly here, whether or not facts_pack.product.financing.lender is set.

proof_bullets.description: Exactly 3 bullets, each one verified claim with a short label and a one-line explanation, chosen to match the ad's angle. Fix cycle 3 item 3: at least 3 of them must be product-benefit claim_ids -- what the sauna does or is built with (e.g. medical-grade red light therapy, full-spectrum near/mid/far infrared, US-owned company, free shipping, limited lifetime warranty) -- not price, shipping-policy, warranty-terms, or returns-policy; the gate fails the page otherwise.

image.description: Optional. The image shown with this bullet in the 'Why this model' block -- an asset_id from facts_pack.assets that shows what the bullet says, different from the hero and from every other image on the page.

ad_proof.description: 3-4 proof tiles, shown in a band right under the buy panel, that answer the ad's own angle point by point (e.g. an ad about hidden costs -> tiles on the published price, free shipping, no electrician needed, the warranty). Each tile is ONE verified claim: a 1-4 word label and a one-sentence text, with at least one claim_id from facts_pack.verified_claims. Prefer claims the proof_bullets do not already use.

faq.description: 5-7 questions a visitor who clicked THIS ad asks before buying, answered from verified facts. Every answer that states a fact (a number, a price, a spec, or one of the trigger words) carries claim_ids.

answer.description: 1-3 sentences. Answer the question first, then the detail.

gallery_order.description: Optional. Up to 5 asset_id strings (plain strings, not objects) from facts_pack.assets, in the order the product gallery should show them after the hero image. Omit to let the renderer order the product's own storefront images.

angle_section.description: 1 H2 + 2-4 short paragraphs (or an image/text pair) expanding what the ad said.

attributed_to_customer.description: True only if this paragraph states a number that comes solely from the ad speaker's own estimate/hedge (ad_brief.speaker_experience), phrased as her own words, never as a brand fact and never carrying a claim_id. Never true anywhere else in this schema (never on a heading, proof_bullets, or specs_table row).

trust_strip.description: warranty, shipping/delivery, returns, review count+rating -- from verified_claims only.

detail_images.description: 1-2 additional detail shots from the asset library.

tagline.description: Optional two-line benefit statement rendered after the proof bullets through the tagline-reveal block (design-skills B11). Omit the field to skip the section.

lines.description: At least two lines. A benefit statement, not a generic section heading.

tagline.description: Optional large-type two-line benefit statement (design-skills B11). Set page.tagline.lines to at least two strings; omit the field to skip.
